title: Ares healed; the goddesses return
intro: Zeus relents because Ares is his son. A rapid cure restores the god; Hera and Athena return after ending his slaughter.

notes.text: “Certainly not … for long”; μάν = μήν, emphatic particle; δηρόν adv.
ἀνέχομαι, tolerate: 1sg fut mid + acc and ptc; ἄλγος, pain: acc pl. “I will not allow you to remain in pain.”
“You are my offspring”; γένος predicate noun, stock / descent; ἐσσί = εἶ.
γείνομαι, bear / beget: unaugmented 3sg aor mid; mother is subject; ἐμοί, “to me.”
τευ = τινός, enclitic gen sg; θεῶν partitive. “From some other one of the gods.”
γίγνομαι: epic 2sg 2aor mid, “had been born”; ὧδε, so; ἀΐδηλος, destructive.
Past unreal condition; ἦσθα 2sg impf of εἰμί. “If you had been born … you would long since have been…”
ἐνέρτερος, lower down, + gen of comparison; Οὐρανίωνες, heavenly gods. Threat of confinement below Olympus.
Παιήων, divine healer: acc sg; ἄνωγα, command: epic 3sg past indicative with movable -ν, not an inf.
ἰάομαι, heal: aor mid inf; Paeëon is to heal Ares.
ὀδυνήφατος, pain-killing (ὀδύνη, pain); φάρμακον, drug / remedy: acc neut pl.
πάσσω, sprinkle / apply: pres act ptc nom sg. ἐπί with the verb: applying remedies to the wound.
ἀκέομαι, heal: 3sg aor mid, ἠκέσατο.
καταθνητός, mortal; τεύχω, make: 3sg plup mid/pass, stative “was constituted / was.” Negated: he is immortal.
ὀπός, plant juice / sap, conventionally fig juice as a milk coagulant. ἐπείγομαι, hasten: pres mid ptc, “swiftly acting.”
συμπήγνυμι, cause to set / curdle: 3sg aor act; gnomic aor in a simile, “as sap curdles milk.”
“Though liquid”; εἰμί pres ptc acc neut sg with milk. ὦκα, quickly.
περιτρέφω, thicken / set: 3sg pres mid/pass. κυκάω, stir: epic pres ptc dat sg, “for the person stirring it.”
καρπαλίμως, swiftly; ἰάομαι 3sg aor mid, heal; θοῦρος, impetuous. The simile illustrates speed of healing.
λούω, bathe: unaugmented 3sg aor; χαρίεις, graceful / lovely: acc neut pl; εἷμα, garment: acc pl.
ἕννυμι, clothe: 3sg aor act; Hebe clothes Ares, with garments as a second accusative.
κῦδος, glory / splendour: uncontracted dat sg; γαίω, rejoice / exult: pres ptc nom sg. Ares resumes his seat beside Zeus.
αἵ, “the two goddesses”; νέομαι, return: unaugmented 3pl impf mid. δῶμα, house / dwelling, here Zeus' palace.
Ἀργείη, Argive, epithet of Hera. Ἀλαλκομενηΐς, Athena's epithet, associated with Alalcomenae; traditional connection also with ἀλαλκεῖν, ward off.
παύω, stop: aor act ptc nom fem pl; Ἄρηα object, gen of what he is stopped from. ἀνδροκτασίη, slaughter of men: gen pl -άων.
Mortal-destroying; Ares' characteristic activity has been interrupted, closing Book V.
